import asyncio

import helpers

SERIAL = 1


# CASE helper_items_op_width_kwonly expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width, *, retries=3):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(*(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width]))


# CASE third_one_with_keyword expect=fire
async def third_one_with_keyword(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, 1, retries=5)


# CASE first_one_with_keyword expect=fire
async def first_one_with_keyword(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(1, items, save, retries=5)


# CASE third_local_min_one expect=fire
async def third_local_min_one(items, save, n):
    width = min(1, n)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE third_module_const expect=fire
async def third_module_const(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, SERIAL)


# CASE third_annotated_local expect=fire
async def third_annotated_local(items, save):
    width: int = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE second_annotated_local expect=fire
async def second_annotated_local(items, save):
    width: int = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, width, save)


# CASE four_positional_retries expect=pass
async def four_positional_retries(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 4, save, 1)


# CASE module_third_one expect=fire
async def module_third_one(items, save):
    await helpers.map_with_concurrency(items, save, 1)


# CASE module_third_min expect=fire
async def module_third_min(items, save, n):
    await helpers.map_with_concurrency(items, save, min(n, 1, len(items)))


# CASE third_four expect=pass
async def third_four(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, 4)


# CASE third_param expect=pass
async def third_param(items, save, width):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)


# CASE kw_width_min_three expect=fire
async def kw_width_min_three(items, save, n):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width=min(n, len(items), 1))


# CASE kw_first_then_positional_none expect=fire
async def kw_all(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(operation=save, width=1, items=items)


# CASE third_one_lambda_op expect=fire
async def third_one_lambda(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, lambda item: save(item), 1)


# CASE third_one_formatted expect=fire
async def third_one_formatted(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(
        items,
        save,
        1,
    )


# CASE kw_local_one expect=fire
async def kw_local_one(items, save):
    width = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width=width)


# CASE kw_module_const expect=fire
async def kw_module_const(items, save):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, limit=SERIAL)


# CASE kw_local_reassigned expect=pass
async def kw_local_reassigned(items, save, fast):
    width = 1
    if fast:
        width = 8
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width=width)


# CASE third_local_reassigned expect=pass
async def third_local_reassigned(items, save, fast):
    width = 1
    if fast:
        width = 8
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, width)
